title: Build: Add stories for `Main` component
body:
Contributes to https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/issues/33245

<!-- If your PR is related to an issue, provide the number(s) above; if it resolves multiple issues, be sure to break them up (e.g. "closes #1000, closes #1001"). -->

<!--

Thank you for contributing to Storybook! Please submit all PRs to the `next` branch unless they are specific to the current release. Storybook maintainers cherry-pick bug and documentation fixes into the `main` branch as part of the release process, so you shouldn't need to worry about this. For additional guidance: https://storybook.js.org/docs/contribute

-->

## What I did

I've added stories for the `Main` UI component, which is at the root of the Manager UI. This is a first step towards running Storybook's UI inside of Storybook itself.

Right now it avoids rendering the preview iframe, because I have not yet been able to have it render a specific story (setting `global.PREVIEW_URL` to `iframe.html` makes it render the ESBuild Metafiles story, because that happens to be the first story in the outer Storybook, whilst not setting it at all causes an infinitely nested Storybook, crashing the browser).

comments.label_reasoning: querySelector can return null and casting it directly to HTMLElement without a null check will cause a runtime null dereference error.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Flags a potential null reference bug and suggests a specific code fix with a guard check.

comments.body: I'm surprised to see this because when I tested, the nested Storybook instance loaded the index of the host Storybook instance in its sidebar. Is this also something you noticed?

comments.author: ghengeveld
comments.body: Yes, the nested instance reuses the index from the host instance rather than the mock. I haven't yet found a way to prevent that.
